ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed primarily at the distal margins and in localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white mottling clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; one distinct high-contrast white circular focal spot located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 75 degrees and a depth of approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; includes sharp, non-uniform peaks and valleys of varying pixel-amplitude, particularly pronounced on the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature initiating from the median notch and extending to sharp, vertically-inclined lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of approximately 5-10 circular white pixel groups concentrated at the extreme distal points of each fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and notched trailing edge topography indicating potential healed tissue loss; distinct white scarring patterns localized at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular isolated, high-contrast bright white circular marker on the interior lower-right surface of the fluke.
